basic_info.description: Loaded with charm, this beautiful home is great for entertaining and has an excellent floor plan featuring two spacious bedrooms and one sunny bathroom on the main level, a large living room and dining room combination with fireplace, a bright remodeled kitchen and beautiful floors. The garage has additional storage space, laundry area, and one-car parking plus the driveway can fit another car. The backyard is ideal for relaxation or fun gatherings. This is a wonderful vibrant location close to an abundance of shops, restaurants, Golden Gate Park and UCSF. Come see this truly special home!
